key.ddbeam.menu: Cast onto the display you look at
ddbeam.source.portal.monitor: Screen (choose it in your desktop's dialog)
ddbeam.source.portal.window: Window (choose it in your desktop's dialog)
ddbeam.cast.started: Casting %s at %s × %s, %s FPS. Stop it with /ddbeam stop or from the display's menu.
ddbeam.notice.shared: Players near the display see your cast.
ddbeam.notice.relay_off: This server does not pass casts on: only you see it.
ddbeam.notice.unknown_display: The server does not know this display: only you see the cast.
ddbeam.notice.not_allowed: Only the display's owner may cast onto it for the others: only you see your cast.
ddbeam.notice.busy: Someone else is casting onto this display: only you see your cast.
ddbeam.error.no_display: Look at a Dream Displays display first.
ddbeam.error.no_source: There is no such source. /ddbeam sources lists them.
ddbeam.error.portal.gi: Casting on Wayland needs python3 with PyGObject (package python3-gi or python-gobject).
ddbeam.error.portal.gstreamer: Casting on Wayland needs GStreamer with its PipeWire plugin (packages gstreamer1.0-pipewire and gstreamer1.0-plugins-good, or gst-plugin-pipewire).
ddbeam.error.portal.failed: Your desktop refused the screen cast (xdg-desktop-portal). Is a portal for your desktop installed?
ddbeam.dialog.title: Cast to display
ddbeam.dialog.who.local: Only you will see it: the server has no Beam.
ddbeam.dialog.who.everyone: Players near the display will see it.
ddbeam.menu.cast.body: Show a screen, an application or a camera on this display, and stream it to the players near it.
ddbeam.command.status.feed: Display %s: caster %s, frames received / decoded / shown %s, audio %s
ddbeam.dialog.share.tip: Players near the display see and hear your cast.
ddbeam.dialog.share.off.title: Streaming to players is not available here
ddbeam.dialog.share.off.body: This server has no Dream Displays Beam (the mod on Fabric or the plugin on Paper). You can still cast; only you see it.
ddbeam.dialog.audio.screen.tip: What your computer plays goes to the other players (you already hear it). The game's own sound is left out on Windows.
ddbeam.dialog.audio.window.tip: Only this application's sound goes to the other players (you already hear it).
ddbeam.dialog.audio.camera.tip: The camera's own audio input, played from the display for everyone, you included.
ddbeam.dialog.camera_mode.tip: What the camera itself sends. Some cameras reach their full size and frame rate only as MJPEG. Applies from the next Go Live / Switch.
